newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: WMC says to restart Kalgoorlie smelter.
newsitem.headline: WMC says to restart Kalgoorlie smelter.

text.p: WMC Ltd said on Friday that it expected to fire up the furnace at its Kalgoorlie nickel smelter in Western Australia either today or tomorrow.
"They are looking to fire up the furnace sometime today or tommorrow and they expect to be operating again on May 16," a WMC spokesman told Reuters.
The smelter has been closed since April 6 when part of the flash furnace roof collapsed.
The company said last month it would use the enforced enclosure to bring forward planned four days of maintenance work set for May and a 14-day shutdown scheduled for October.
"We are expecting to lose about 5,000 tonnes (of nickel matte production)," the spokesman said.
WMC had previously estimated lost production of 7,000 tonnes from a 30-day smelter shutdown.
